notes: τὸ κατ᾽ ἐμέ is split three ways: the substantival article takes 'as much as' headed on the nominal 'much' (rules 22, 31), the preposition carries the supplied copula (rules 53, 62), and the pronoun stands alone.
τοῖς before a verbless prepositional modifier keeps the supplied relativizer under rule 31's carve-out, ὑμῖν notwithstanding, because nothing else in the modifier can carry it.
εὐαγγελίσασθαι heads on 'gospel' under rule 91, no part of 'preach' glossing the lexeme; the ASV's own gloss corroborates.
